purpose: Executive summary of current/listing-period market conditions, quality/readiness, and reliable hot/cold evidence.
required_visual_pattern: KPI cards; compact monthly trend; Top-5 HOT table; Top-5 COLD table
fixed_scope: Apartment-sale asking-price context; Top-5 HOT/COLD uses four-city reliable neighborhood view.
reliability_and_semantic_note: Always show asking-price/currency caveat and readiness status.

purpose: Surface pipeline readiness and documented review states without duplicating engineering QA.
required_visual_pattern: Pipeline readiness KPI; Gold QA KPI; critical/review counts; component status matrix
fixed_scope: Global metadata; analytical slicers do not recompute upstream QA.
reliability_and_semantic_note: M2 REVIEW may remain ready=True; do not coerce it to PASS.

purpose: Reliable neighborhood asking-price map/ranking plus Listing-Market Temperature evidence.
required_visual_pattern: Price map; reliable neighborhood price ranking; market-temperature ranking; sample/reliability tooltip
fixed_scope: Price map/temperature are apartment-sale; temperature Top-5 presentation uses is_four_city=True.
reliability_and_semantic_note: No exact coordinates; temperature is not liquidity/absorption.

purpose: Monthly deduplicated listing activity and asking-price-per-sqm trend on a coherent apartment-sale population.
required_visual_pattern: Supply combo chart; asking-price combo chart; optional raw-vs-dedup/supply-scope context
fixed_scope: Primary price+activity series_kind=price_and_supply; entity level chosen from location slicers.
reliability_and_semantic_note: Listing activity is platform flow, not physical inventory.

purpose: Controlled price associations, held-out predictive contribution, and AVM quality/error evidence.
required_visual_pattern: 3 model KPI cards; adjusted-association bar with CI; permutation-importance bar; error-analysis tooltip/table
reliability_and_semantic_note: Use “association/contrast” and “predictive contribution”; never causal wording.

purpose: Agency-vs-personal descriptive and adjusted asking-price comparison.
required_visual_pattern: Adjusted difference + CI KPI; raw vs adjusted comparison; counts/shares; selected-user descriptive KPI
reliability_and_semantic_note: User Type is disconnected semantic selection; it does not refit adjusted estimate.

purpose: Six manually validated text signals: fixed adjusted price association plus monthly prevalence.
required_visual_pattern: Validated-signal KPIs; adjusted-effect forest/bar; monthly prevalence trend
fixed_scope: Sale-only. Month applies to prevalence, not fixed adjusted effects.
reliability_and_semantic_note: Manual precision and FDR/q-value must remain visible in tooltip/table.

purpose: Five final Market Types / Descriptive Typology profiles, positioning, amenity profile, and monthly mix.
required_visual_pattern: 3 segment KPIs; profile table; area-vs-relative-price scatter; amenity profile; monthly mix
fixed_scope: Sale-market segmentation; segment identity stays in marts (no dim_segment).
reliability_and_semantic_note: Do not call fallback types stable clusters; N/A property applicability must remain visible.
